SISON First Vice President Philippine Nafional Bank 7/F PNB Financial Center Pres. Disdado Macapagal Blvd., Pasay City Sir: This refers to your request for this Department's legal opinion on whether or not a Sanggunjang Bayan resoJution authorjzjng a Joan application needs to be approved and confirmed by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan. We reply in the negative. Please be adv'lsed that the authority of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan to review the acts of its component municipalities is limited to reviewing only (1) ordinances or (2) resolutions approving local development pians and public investment programs, per the provisions of Sec. 56(a) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160). The review authority of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan does not extend to resolutions enacted by its component municipalities which authorize the latter's Mayor to enter into a contract of loan. Likewise, the law (RA 71 60) neither requires such resolutions to be approved nor confirmed by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan. We hope we have enlightened you on the matter. TERESIT ASTILLO Undersecretary cc:Dir-RodoIfo S. Feraren DILG NCR
